2dcb2338f50d8ecf.description: Job description Overview Our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver positive employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era. At Small Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team—one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation. SME&C is more than a sales organization—it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career. Together, we are shaping the future of business. Join Microsoft as an AI Business Process Digital Solution Area Specialist. In this individual-contributor, quota-carrying role you will own the entire engagement cycle, pinpointing opportunities, crafting value propositions, and driving AI-powered business-process transformations. Partnering closely with Account Executives, Digital Solution Engineers, and marketing teams, you will design win strategies, deliver compelling demos and pilots, and land customer success plans that accelerate adoption of Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Copilot solutions. Leveraging deep domain expertise and consultative selling skills, you will translate complex scenarios into clear business outcomes, remove blockers, and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets. You will also share practices, expand your technical depth, and act as a trusted advisor who connects Microsoft innovation to measurable customer impact, advancing your own career growth in solution sales and cloud technologies. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities Partner with and lead Account Planning Team on Account Plan for AI Business Process opportunities, including decision maker identification and solution play selection. Establish and build C-Suite and Business Decision Maker (BDM) relationships. Build & maintain the required range of qualified pipeline coverage for rolling 4 quarters through digital-first seller tools Deliver the One Microsoft narrative and solution pitches to C-Suite executives and Business Decision Makers. Orchestrate business value + technical solution demos to align with the customers’ desired business outcomes and solution requirements. Manage long-term contract renewals with existing accounts to ensure long-term satisfaction and success. Actively and regularly engage in sales community calls/channels and share learnings and practices. Qualifications Technology-related sales or account management experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field AND technology-related sales or account management experience OR equivalent experience Preferred Qualifications (PQs) Deep understanding of CRM and/or ERP applications including Marketing Automation, Sales Automation, Relationship Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Finance, Supply Chain Management and Commerce and how they translate into business impact and value This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

2d475cc437ecdffb.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Director, Talent Development to provide strategic leadership and oversight for all learning, technical, and Saudi talent development initiatives. This full-time role, based in Al Jubail, Eastern region, is responsible for building a future-ready workforce by aligning talent development strategies with business objectives, Saudi national workforce priorities, and industry standards. The Director ensures integration, consistency, and effectiveness across all development programs while maintaining strong governance and compliance. Key Responsibilities Develop and own the company's Talent Development strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, operational needs, and long-term workforce planning. Translate business strategy into integrated learning, technical, and Saudi talent development roadmaps. Provide governance, direction, and performance oversight to all Talent Development departments. Oversee the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Learning & Development programs, technical and industrial training frameworks, and Saudi Talent Development initiatives, including Young Professionals and Young Technicians programs. Ensure consistency, quality, and scalability of programs across business units and facilities. Ensure full compliance with Quality Management System requirements, Health, Safety, and Environmental standards, and Saudi development and regulatory requirements. Guide, support, and coach Talent Development Managers to ensure strong performance and future leadership readiness. Encourage a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and high standards among employees. Ensure Talent Development teams are properly staffed and possess the necessary skills to meet business needs. Act as the organization’s senior representative for talent development with educational institutions and training partners. Manage and control the Talent Development budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness, resource optimization, and measurable return on investment. Approve major vendor engagements, certifications, and strategic training initiatives. Establish KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms to measure training program effectiveness, workforce capability improvement, and business impact. Provide regular strategic reports to executive leadership on progress, risks, outcomes, and improvement opportunities. Ensure data-driven decision-making across all development initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or Organizational Leadership is preferred. Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in talent development, learning, or workforce development. At least 5 years of experience in a leadership role overseeing multiple talent development functions. Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or technical environments is preferred. Work Environment This role operates within the dynamic environment of ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail, focusing on strategic talent development initiatives to support the company's operational and long-term objectives in Al Jubail.

2d934d24260513e4.description: Company Description NAI Saudi Arabia operates as part of NAI Global, a leading commercial real estate services firm with a strong international presence. NAI Global offices collaborate across more than 300 locations in North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa, and Asia Pacific to deliver tailored real estate solutions. The network includes over 5,100 local market professionals who collectively manage more than 100 million square meters of property. Each year, NAI Global completes over $20 billion in commercial real estate transactions worldwide. Joining NAI Saudi Arabia means working within a respected global organization that values professionalism, service quality, and teamwork. Role Description The Tea Boy role at NAI Saudi Arabia is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves preparing and serving tea, coffee, and other refreshments to staff, clients, and visitors throughout the day, ensuring timely and courteous service. Responsibilities include maintaining cleanliness and organization in pantry and refreshment areas, restocking supplies, and ensuring all equipment is properly cleaned and stored. The Tea Boy supports office operations by assisting with meeting room setup related to refreshments, collecting used cups and dishes, and coordinating with administrative staff when larger events or client visits require beverage service. The position requires a consistent focus on hygiene, respectful interaction with colleagues and guests, and reliability in performing assigned duties. Qualifications Candidates should possess basic food and beverage preparation skills, including making tea, coffee, and simple refreshments to a consistent standard. Candidates should possess good hygiene and cleanliness practices, with the ability to maintain tidy pantry areas, manage dishwashing, and follow safety procedures. Candidates should possess customer service and interpersonal skills, including politeness, respect for all staff and visitors, and a professional attitude. Candidates should possess time management and organizational skills, such as prioritizing beverage service during busy periods and coordinating with office schedules. Candidates should possess basic communication skills in English and/or Arabic to understand instructions and respond appropriately to requests. Previous experience in a similar support, hospitality, or office service role is beneficial. Ability to stand and move around for extended periods and perform light lifting as part of daily duties. Commitment to punctuality, reliability, and respectful

2d948ef526ad89a8.description: About the Role AREEB is seeking a Procurement Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is designed for professionals with 0-1 years of experience. The Procurement Engineer will play a crucial role in supporting project planning and ensuring the timely and accurate procurement of necessary materials and supplies. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to leverage technical knowledge of materials and supplies to facilitate the completion of projects from initiation to conclusion. This involves managing the technical aspects of contracts and identifying required items and their suppliers to support project execution effectively. Key Responsibilities Communicate and coordinate regularly with internal departments to ensure efficient delivery of items. Study, review, and divide new projects into manageable packages for team distribution. Update the weekly progress plan report daily and compare planned progress against actual data. Follow up with the tender department to stay informed on all offers sent to subcontractors. Coordinate with the planning department regarding project updates to plan for necessary items. Liaise with the purchasing department on the availability of required items and obtain supplier recommendations. Prepare the technical components of contracts for submission with the final contract draft. Required Experience 0-1 years of experience in procurement or a related engineering field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the AREEB team. The role involves significant coordination across various departments to ensure project success. Application Process Candidates interested in this Procurement Engineer role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $3.9B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism. Manages the GSE maintenance section tool control program and tool room operations. Maintains accountability for all tool room assets. Issue and receipt of all tools, test sets, and other TMDE equipment assigned to the tool room. Provide other tool room operations and support as outlined in appropriate directives. Manages the GSE Maintenance section calibration control program and account for all TMDE. Ensure all TMDE items bare the proper markings/labeling. Turn-in all TMDE (Test, Measurement, & Diagnostic Equipment) items for calibration. Order, Track, and Maintain supplies necessary for maintenance as both bench stock and as needed. Demonstrated performance in Aviation Operations activities from previous job positions. Possess a valid driver’s license and Passport. This commitment, aligned with our core Vision and Values of Integrity, Respect, and Responsibility, allows us to leverage differences, encourage innovation, and expand our success in the global marketplace, ultimately enabling us to best serve our clients.

2d3142a800548097.description: About Boutique Group and The Red Palace Boutique Group is reimagining The Red Palace, a historic landmark built in 1943, as an ultra-luxury boutique hotel in Riyadh. This establishment blends historical elegance with contemporary sophistication, offering a unique experience that honors Saudi Arabia's heritage through meticulously restored architecture and curated cultural experiences. The Red Palace aims to provide unparalleled service while respecting its legacy. Role Summary The Chief Accountant is responsible for overseeing the company's accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This full-time role in Riyadh involves effective management of accounting staff and plays a key part in financial planning, analysis, and safeguarding the company’s assets. The Chief Accountant will act as second-in-command to the Director of Finance. Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and inspire the accounting team, fostering accountability and professional growth. Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant preparation of financial statements, statutory filings, and management reports in line with local regulations and accounting standards. Oversee all accounting functions, including Credit Manager, Accounts Payable, General Cashier cum Paymaster, Income Auditor, Cost Controller, Fixed Assets, and balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring timely month-end closing. Monitor cash flow, budgets, and forecasts; provide actionable insights to optimize financial performance and support strategic objectives. Develop, implement, and maintain robust accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls to enhance efficiency and risk management. Coordinate and support internal and external audits, liaise with tax authorities, and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Partner with department heads and leadership to provide financial guidance, cost management, and resource allocation strategies. Maintain effective internal and external communication with management, finance teams, auditors, tax authorities, suppliers, and key customers. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, encourage best practices, and leverage technology to enhance the accounting function. Ensure the capital replacement and disposal policy is enforced and that all reporting complies with local accounting and tax rules. Provide value-added business performance reporting and accurate forecasting to support operational improvements and resource allocation. Lead the Finance team to drive improved performance and develop talent, creating succession planning within the Palace and the Group. Support the Director of Finance in driving the annual budgeting and forecasting process. Administer accounting policies and procedures, adhere to procurement practices, prepare financial statements, and ensure compliance with Boutique Group and Red Palace standards. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Professional certification (CPA, CMA, ACCA) is preferred. 5–8 years of progressive accounting experience, including 2–3 years in a senior accounting or supervisory role. Hotel pre-opening experience is strongly preferred. Deep knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards, and regulatory requirements. Proficiency in accounting software, ERP systems, and MS Office applications. Required Skills Strong leadership, analytical, organizational, and strategic thinking skills. Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and ethical standards. Application Information This full-time position offers an opportunity to contribute to a significant project in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

2d3e2b60f53e1b4f.description: About the Role Tahreez Sport and Entertainment (TSE) is seeking a Senior Technology Adviser to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, client-facing role with an initial duration of 12 months, focusing on sports, entertainment, stadium, and major venue projects in the region. The successful candidate will collaborate with senior clients to develop technology strategies, define requirements, and create practical solutions aligned with business and operational objectives. Role Context This position involves working from the early stages of projects, assisting clients in making informed technology decisions and translating concepts into clear strategies and roadmaps. The role contributes to bringing venue and live environment technologies into Saudi Arabia, enhancing safety, operational efficiency, connectivity, and audience experience across various venues. Responsibilities Lead and support technology advisory projects across Saudi Arabia. Work directly with senior client stakeholders to understand goals and challenges. Develop technology strategies, roadmaps, requirements, and recommendations. Lead workshops and stakeholder sessions, and create high-quality presentations and reports. Advise on technology solutions for stadiums, arenas, sports, entertainment, and major venues. Collaborate with PMY’s technology, design, digital, and delivery teams to develop integrated solutions. Support proposals, tenders, RFPs, and business development activities. Build relationships with clients, partners, and technology providers. Stay informed on emerging technology and industry trends. Travel within Saudi Arabia as required. Contribute to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace in accordance with company Occupational Health and Safety policies, operational standards, and relevant legislative requirements. Company Overview Tahreez Sport & Entertainment (TSE) is a joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group. Tahreez is a Saudi technology and solutions company with operational capabilities across multiple sectors. PMY Group is a global leader in technology, data, and creative solutions for live environments. TSE combines local insight with global experience to deliver integrated venue technologies and operational solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, and audience experiences across stadiums, arenas, and live entertainment environments throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Team and Impact The role involves working alongside industry professionals and global specialists in venue technologies, integrated systems, operations, and live event environments. TSE aims to deliver intelligent technologies that enhance safety, operational efficiency, connectivity, and audience experience across the Kingdom. The company is committed to fostering an environment that supports professional growth and hands-on experience on ambitious projects. Application Information This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for a period of 12 months. Salary details are not disclosed.

2d49d42d89a8760c.description: About Parsons Corporation Parsons Corporation cultivates an innovative culture that empowers its employees. The company focuses on valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth. This approach supports employees in achieving their full potential within a professional environment. The Role of Technical Manager - Landscape Parsons is seeking a Technical Manager - Landscape to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covering projects in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves providing technical leadership and governance for landscape architecture projects. The manager will oversee multidisciplinary coordination, ensure technical excellence, manage resources, maintain quality assurance, and drive delivery performance across complex and large-scale developments. Key Responsibilities Lead the technical direction and delivery of landscape architecture projects across all design stages, from concept through IFC documentation. Act as the discipline lead responsible for technical quality, compliance, design consistency, and project delivery standards. Manage and supervise Senior Landscape Architects, Landscape Architects, BIM Coordinators, and technical production teams. Establish project execution strategies, technical protocols, and discipline-specific delivery plans. Conduct detailed technical reviews of drawings, specifications, BOQs, reports, BIM models, and design packages before submission. Lead multidisciplinary coordination with Architecture, Urban Design, Master Planning, MEP, Structural, Infrastructure, and Digital Engineering teams. Ensure compliance with local authority requirements, international standards, sustainability requirements, and client design guidelines. Oversee QA/QC processes and ensure all deliverables meet Parsons' technical standards. Identify technical risks, design gaps, constructability issues, and coordination conflicts, implementing mitigation measures. Support project directors and project managers in resource planning, budgeting, staffing, and delivery forecasting. Lead technical workshops, design reviews, value engineering exercises, and client presentations. Drive BIM implementation, digital delivery processes, automation tools, and continuous improvement initiatives within the landscape discipline. Support business development activities, proposal reviews, fee estimates, and technical input for new opportunities. Required Qualifications and Skills Minimum of 15 years of professional experience in landscape architecture, including large-scale multidisciplinary projects. Minimum of 7 years of experience in a technical leadership, discipline lead, or management role. Strong experience delivering major mixed-use, hospitality, residential, public realm, infrastructure, and master planned developments. Advanced knowledge of hardscape, softscape, irrigation, grading, site development, and landscape construction methodologies. Extensive experience in design management, technical reviews, and construction documentation production. Proven experience managing multidisciplinary coordination and resolving complex technical interfaces. Strong understanding of Saudi Arabian and GCC regulations, standards, and project delivery requirements. Demonstrated experience implementing QA/QC procedures and technical governance frameworks. Strong commercial awareness with experience supporting resource planning and project performance management. Excellent client-facing, leadership, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Desired Qualifications and Skills Master's Degree in Landscape Architecture, Urban Design, or a related field. Chartered, Registered, or Professional Landscape Architecture accreditation. Experience leading technical delivery for giga-projects and major urban developments in the GCC. Advanced BIM and Digital Delivery experience, including Autodesk Construction Cloud and multidisciplinary model coordination. Knowledge of sustainability frameworks, environmental design, and resilient landscape strategies. Experience managing geographically distributed design teams. Strong mentoring and talent development capabilities. Ability to establish discipline standards, technical procedures, and best practices across multiple projects. Experience supporting pursuits, technical proposals, and strategic project planning. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

2d6cd24f9742ea4a.description: About the Role Four Points by Sheraton in Riyadh is seeking a Guest Experience Expert to join their team. This full-time role focuses on creating memorable and personalized experiences for guests throughout their stay, extending beyond standard check-in and check-out procedures. The position involves guiding guests and addressing their needs to ensure a smooth and enjoyable visit. Key Responsibilities Deliver a range of services to guests, guiding them through their entire stay. Process operational needs and address guest requests promptly. Complete necessary reports and documentation. Share information about local area highlights with guests. Assist guests with loading and unloading vehicles. Transport luggage to and from guest rooms and designated bell areas. Workplace Standards and Physical Requirements All team members are expected to maintain a safe workplace, adhere to company policies and procedures, ensure confidentiality, protect company assets, and uphold quality standards. Professional appearance and communication are essential. This role requires physical activity, including standing, sitting, or walking for extended periods, and moving through confined or elevated spaces. Tasks involve lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and up to 100 pounds with assistance. Reaching overhead and below the knees, bending, twisting, and stooping are also required. Qualifications and Experience Education: High school diploma or *** equivalent. Related Work Experience: No related work experience is required (0-1 years). Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required. License or Certification: None required. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

2d6d7fbccd61991b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن محاسب قانوني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة الأنظمة المالية والمستندات، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق الحسابات الختامية وإعداد التقارير المالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمحاسبين الطموحين لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في مجال التدقيق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة النظام المالي ونظام الرقابة الداخلي المعتمد للجهات المعنية. مراجعة المستندات المؤيدة للقيود المحاسبية والمطالبات المالية، وتدقيق اكتمال الشروط المالية والقانونية ومطابقتها للمعايير المحاسبية. مراجعة وتدقيق كشوف الحسابات الختامية في ضوء الموازنة السنوية والنظام المالي المعتمد. إعداد التقارير بنتائج فحص الحسابات وتحليل نتائج المراجعة. فحص الدفاتر والسجلات المالية وتقديم الاقتراحات والتوصيات لتحسين الأداء. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال المحاسبة القانونية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال المحاسبة القانونية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة أو التدقيق. فهم جيد للمبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق المستندات المالية بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. دقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل في مراجعة البيانات المالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة لإعداد التقارير وتقديم التوصيات. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم التطور المهني في مجال المحاسبة القانونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

2d7ef19ab203e657.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة بتحليل العينات، مع الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفقًا للطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات. الالتزام بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع المواد الكيميائية والعينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية بدقة. الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات جيدة في التعامل مع الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. القدرة على تسجيل وتوثيق نتائج التحاليل بدقة. معرفة بإجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكيمياء ضمن بيئة مختبرية في أبها، عسير، ويتطلب الدور التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل لضمان سير العمليات المخبرية بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

2d8fc5771ac453a6.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm focused on delivering projects that positively impact communities worldwide. The company partners with clients to address complex challenges and build legacies for future generations, contributing to improvements in commutes, power supply, water access, and urban development. The Role of Architect AECOM is seeking an Architect to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. The Architect will be responsible for ensuring architectural design compliance, coordinating various building elements, and developing solutions for complex challenges, particularly within entertainment venues and specialized fit-out projects. Key Responsibilities Review and assess architectural shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, technical proposals, and interface details for compliance with design intent and project specifications. Coordinate and integrate architectural elements such as partitions, ceilings, flooring, wall finishes, and joinery with structural, MEP, lighting, AV, show, and ride systems to ensure seamless design execution and buildability. Identify drawing discrepancies, spatial clashes, and site constraints; coordinate technical clarifications and develop buildable solutions in collaboration with specialists and consultants. Monitor all installations for dimensional accuracy, workmanship quality, accessibility compliance, and adherence to approved architectural details and specifications. Review material samples and mock-ups for architectural compliance, aesthetic quality, and successful integration with adjoining works and finishes. Support comprehensive inspections, snagging activities, corrective actions, and verification of completed works in coordination with quality assurance and project management teams. Review and validate architectural as-built drawings for accuracy and completeness; support final handover procedures and documentation. 2dc7e0bf02e28e26.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إمكان الطبية عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. متابعة عمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج، ومراقبة سير العمل، ووضع وتتبع موازناتها وإجراءاتها التعاقدية، وتحديد تكاليفها ومصادر تمويلها. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع والبرامج الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء مراحل المشروع الرئيسية وإغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مدير إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة بكفاءة وفعالية. ملخص الوظيفة المسمى الوظيفي: مدير إدارة مشاريع الشركة: إمكان الطبية الموقع: الرياض نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الخبرة المطلوبة: 2-5 سنوات

2d001b82147415fe.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks Talent & Strategy is seeking a Quality and Safety Officer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the effective implementation and continuous monitoring of the Safety Management System (SMS) and Quality Management System (QMS) at Gateway Facilities, ensuring full compliance with GACA regulatory requirements. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide Quality and Safety coverage from the assigned base location at Riyadh Airport. Extend Quality and Safety support to Dammam Airport and designated MODON industrial warehouses in Khamis Mushayt, Hail, and Medina through planned monthly visits. Ensure consistent implementation, monitoring, and follow-up of Safety and Quality requirements across assigned locations. Support the effective implementation and continuous improvement of the Safety Management System (SMS) and Quality Management System (QMS). Internal Control and Administration Conduct internal inspections and compliance monitoring in line with approved inspection plans. Monitor corrective and preventive actions to ensure timely and effective closure. Verify compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. Manage safety reports, non-conformities, and quality findings. Coordinate investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes. Maintain safety and quality records and documentation. 2d10a87bd8f9a9ad.description: About the Role The Saudi Automobile and Motorcycle Federation is seeking a Procurement Assistant Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves managing procurement requirements from initiation through completion, ensuring all activities comply with approved policies and procedures. Role Overview The Procurement Assistant Manager coordinates with internal stakeholders and service providers, monitors service level agreement (SLA) performance, and resolves operational bottlenecks. The position is critical for ensuring procurement activities are completed on time and in adherence to the Delegation of Authority. Key Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end procurement cycle, from purchase requisition initiation through purchase order issuance, contracting, and closure, coordinating with departments, the procurement service provider, and relevant stakeholders. Monitor procurement SLAs and maintain trackers and dashboards covering requests, approvals, delays, bottlenecks, risks, and escalations. Coordinate Requests for Quotation (RFQs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and tenders, including scopes, specifications, bidder communications, evaluations, and award documentation. Support sourcing, market assessments, and supplier evaluations, and prepare commercial comparisons and recommendations. Monitor supplier performance against contracts and SLAs/Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), maintain performance records, and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure compliance with procurement policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and the Delegation of Authority, escalating exceptions and maintaining complete documentation and audit trails. Support annual procurement planning and track implementation, commitments, upcoming requirements, and critical deadlines. Analyze procurement data, resolve escalated issues, and recommend savings opportunities and improvements to workflows, SLAs, SOPs, and controls. Provide the Director of Shared Services with procurement reports and executive updates, and support audits and governance reviews. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in procurement management. Demonstrated ability to manage procurement cycles from initiation to completion. Experience in coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Saudi Automobile and Motorcycle Federation. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed to qualified candidates.

2d4782d3cdf3b37d.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث المعهد العالي للتقنيات الورقية والصناعية عن مهندس صناعي للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم تدريب أكاديمي وتطبيقي عالي الجودة لطلبة سنة الدبلوم، مع التركيز على تعزيز قدراتهم الأكاديمية والمهارية وتأهيلهم للمراحل التعليمية والتخصصات اللاحقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. الهدف من الوظيفة تتمثل المهمة الأساسية لمهندس صناعي في تنفيذ البرامج التعليمية والتدريبية المعتمدة لطلبة الدبلوم، بما يضمن تحقيق أهداف البرنامج التخصصي ورفع مستوى جاهزية المتدربين. يشمل ذلك تطوير المحتوى التعليمي، وتقييم الأداء، وتقديم الدعم اللازم للطلبة لضمان انتقالهم السلس إلى المرحلة الجامعية والتخصصات المختلفة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ برامج التدريب الخاصة بسنة الدبلوم وفق الخطة المعتمدة، بما يشمل التحضير وتقديم المحتوى والتقويم والتفاعل مع المتدربين. إعداد وتطبيق اختبارات تحديد المستوى ومتابعة نتائجها لتحسين مستوى الأداء التدريبي للمتدربين. تطوير المادة العلمية وتحديثها دوريًا بما يتناسب مع احتياجات المرحلة ومستجدات التدريب. استخدام أساليب ووسائل تعليمية حديثة لتحفيز المتدربين وتحقيق أهداف التعلم. متابعة الحضور والانضباط السلوكي والمهني والتقني والأكاديمي للمتدربين داخل قاعات التدريب. إعداد التقارير الدورية عن أداء المتدربين ورفعها للإدارة المختصة. المشاركة في الاجتماعات والورش التدريبية والدورات التطويرية الخاصة بالفريق التدريبي. تقديم الدعم التدريبي والإرشادي للطلبة عند الحاجة. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ضمن نطاق عمله يكلف بها من قبل الإدارة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الصناعية أو التدريب الأكاديمي والتطبيقي. القدرة على تطوير وتقديم المحتوى التعليمي والتدريبي. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتفاعل مع المتدربين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الدورية وتحليل البيانات. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الصناعي ضمن فريق تعليمي متخصص في المعهد العالي للتقنيات الورقية والصناعية بمدينة جدة. تتسم بيئة العمل بالتركيز على التطوير المستمر للمتدربين والفريق التدريبي، وتوفر فرصًا للمشاركة في ورش العمل والدورات التطويرية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرات. ندعو المهندسين الصناعيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالتدريب الأكاديمي والتطبيقي للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

2d6e9706fc6e9d81.description: About Tharwah Group Tharwah Group (Saudi Exchange, Nomu: 9606) is a Saudi human capability company. Through its subsidiaries Tharwah Consulting, Tharwah Academy, Amjad Watan, and Tharwah Technologies, the group supports government and private-sector organizations in building the workforce and leadership capabilities required by Vision 2030. Tharwah Group also develops Taqm, an agentic AI workforce platform. The company is currently implementing AI within its own operations, utilizing AI agents for transactional work and equipping leaders with agents to enhance management and decision-making. The Role of Group AI Enablement Lead The Group AI Enablement Lead will drive the group-wide AI agenda, transitioning from strategic planning to the implementation and regular use of AI agents in production. This role is situated within the Group's Strategy & Performance Office, working directly with executive leadership and the heads of all subsidiaries and shared functions. This is an operational role focused on tangible delivery, not a research or advisory position. Performance will be measured by live agents, demonstrable cost reductions in processes, and actual adoption by leaders. Key Responsibilities in the First 12 Months Implement the initial wave of AI agents across finance, procurement, bids, government portals, and customer experience. Each agent will have a designated owner, service level, controls, and an audit trail. Establish a cost-per-transaction baseline for each process prior to automation and report on achieved savings. Deploy leadership agents for executives and managers, focusing on driving consistent weekly adoption rather than just license counts. Develop agent specifications and evaluation sets, and approve or reject builds from the internal technology team. Collaborate with Legal and Internal Audit to establish the AI governance model, addressing data access by role, PDPL compliance, SDAIA AI ethics principles, and NCA controls. Build and develop a network of process owners and AI champions across the group. Transform the internal AI program into a reference case for Tharwah's Workforce AI Enablement offering for clients. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience, including at least two operating-model or process transformations where technology was successfully implemented and adoption measured. Practical experience in building AI agents or LLM-based workflows for real-world use, encompassing prompts, tool utilization, evaluation, and failure handling. Candidates should be able to demonstrate their work. Strong process architecture skills, from policy and procedure development to workflow and ERP configuration. A proven track record of influencing changes in how middle managers operate, supported by data. Ability to construct business cases and monitor achieved savings. Professional fluency in both Arabic and English, with credibility among senior Saudi executives. Desired Attributes Experience in shared services, finance operations, or HR operations transformation. Proficiency with Odoo or other major ERP systems (*, SAP, Oracle) at a process or configuration level. Experience within a listed company or regulated environment. A background in consulting or professional services combined with in-house delivery experience. Compensation and Application Process This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and offers performance-linked pay, with variable compensation tied to the value delivered. Saudi nationals are encouraged to apply. To apply, please submit your application through LinkedIn and complete the screening questions. Shortlisted candidates will proceed to a written exercise, followed by a practical design session based on a real Tharwah process.

2dfc45f6913fd73d.description: هل تمتلك خبرة في قيادة الفرق وتشغيل المواقع الترفيهية؟ تعلن ENTER10 عن توفر فرصة وظيفية لمشرف فرع، لقيادة التشغيل اليومي وتقديم تجربة مميزة لضيوفنا في بيئة عمل حيوية ومتجددة. المهام والمسؤوليات: الإشراف على تشغيل الفرع يوميًا، والتأكد من جاهزية جميع الأقسام قبل استقبال الزوار. متابعة تشغيل مرافق الفرع، بما يشمل البولينج، والألعاب الإلكترونية، والبلياردو، وألعاب الفيديو، والواقع الافتراضي والكاريوكي، والفوتوبوث، والكوفي، والفعاليات، بحسب الخدمات المتوفرة في الفرع. تنظيم وتوزيع المهام على الموظفين ومتابعة أدائهم والتزامهم بالزي والسلوك المهني. إعداد جداول الورديات ومتابعة الحضور والانصراف والتأخير، ورفع الملاحظات المتعلقة بالموظفين للجهة المختصة. تدريب الموظفين الجدد ومساندة الفريق ميدانيًا، وتحفيزهم على التعاون وتحقيق أهداف الفرع. استقبال الزوار والترحيب بهم، ومتابعة جودة الخدمة وسرعة تلبية احتياجاتهم. معالجة ملاحظات العملاء وشكاواهم باحترافية، والتصعيد عند الحاجة وفق إجراءات الشركة. متابعة المبيعات والتأكد من تطبيق الأسعار والعروض والتعليمات المعتمدة دون اجتهاد أو تغيير غير مصرح به. تشجيع البيع الإضافي والتعريف بالخدمات والباقات المناسبة للزوار بطريقة لائقة. الإشراف على عمليات الكاشير ونقاط البيع، ومتابعة الفواتير والإغلاقات اليومية، ورفع أي فروقات أو ملاحظات مالية فورًا. متابعة الحجوزات والمجموعات والفعاليات، والتنسيق مع الفريق لضمان تنفيذها بالشكل المتفق عليه. التأكد من نظافة الفرع وترتيب مناطق الألعاب والمرافق والمستودعات ومناطق استقبال الزوار. إجراء جولات تفقدية دورية للتأكد من سلامة الأجهزة والمرافق، ورفع بلاغات الأعطال ومتابعة الصيانة حتى إتمامها. إيقاف استخدام أي جهاز أو منطقة يظهر فيها خلل قد يؤثر على سلامة الزوار أو الموظفين، وإبلاغ المسؤول المختص فورًا. متابعة توفر المواد والمستلزمات التشغيلية، ورفع طلبات النواقص والمخزون وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. تطبيق تعليمات السلامة والأمن وإجراءات الطوارئ، والإبلاغ عن الحوادث والمخاطر وتوثيقها حسب النموذج المعتمد. التأكد من التزام الموظفين بالسياسات والإجراءات والتعاميم والعروض المعتمدة من الشركة. إعداد التقارير اليومية عن المبيعات، والحضور، والحجوزات، والأعطال، والشكاوى، والحوادث، وأبرز ملاحظات التشغيل. التنسيق المستمر مع الإدارات المعنية، مثل الموارد البشرية والمحاسبة والصيانة والتسويق، لضمان معالجة احتياجات الفرع. المحافظة على أصول الشركة ومعداتها، ومنع الاستخدام غير المصرح به أو الإهمال، ورفع أي ملاحظة بهذا الشأن. تنفيذ مهام فتح الفرع وإغلاقه والتأكد من استكمال قوائم الفحص والتسليم بين الورديات. تقديم مقترحات عملية لتحسين تجربة الزوار ورفع كفاءة التشغيل والمبيعات. المؤهلات والمتطلبات: خبرة سابقة في الإشراف على فرع أو فريق عمل، ويفضل في الترفيه أو الضيافة . مهارات قيادية وتنظيمية وقدرة على توزيع المهام ومتابعة تنفيذها. إجادة التعامل مع العملاء وحل المشكلات وضبط المواقف تحت الضغط. مهارات أساسية في استخدام الحاسب وأنظمة نقاط البيع وإعداد التقارير. الالتزام والانضباط والقدرة على العمل بنظام الورديات، بما فيها عطلات نهاية الأسبوع والمواسم. القدرة على العمل ميدانيًا ومتابعة تفاصيل التشغيل على مدار الوردية. يفضل وجود مؤهل مناسب وخبرة في متابعة المبيعات والمخزون وخدمة العملاء لمراكز الترفيه.

2dc92496501e99f1.description: About the Role ASMO is seeking a Cybersecurity Operation Center Analyst to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the performance, security, and reliability of ASMO's Cybersecurity systems and applications. The analyst will work to prevent cybersecurity incidents, remediate them promptly if they occur, and identify related threats, vulnerabilities, and risks. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in the field. Key Objectives The primary objective of this role is to maintain the integrity of ASMO's cybersecurity posture. This involves preventing incidents, responding effectively to security events, and proactively identifying and mitigating threats. The analyst will collaborate with stakeholders to implement appropriate cybersecurity controls across the organization's technical environment. Responsibilities Investigate and validate cybersecurity incidents. Respond to cybersecurity incidents and implement containment measures. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of ASMO's technical environment, including cloud infrastructures, networks, solutions, and applications. Report on incidents and security posture to the SOC Manager and ASMO management. Facilitate the onboarding and integration of SIEM tools with existing infrastructure and systems, addressing any integration issues. Develop, maintain, and test the Incident Response (IR) plan. Review and ensure complete visibility of the ASMO environment, taking action to address identified gaps. Utilize threat intelligence reports to enhance security and incident response capabilities. Analyze trends and emerging threats from intelligence data to identify proactive protection measures. Participate in regular review meetings with the SOC provider to assess service effectiveness. Handle ongoing Cybersecurity operational activities and objectives. Ensure ASMO’s data, systems, and networks are protected by appropriate Cybersecurity controls and provide security-related support to users. Oversee and manage outsourced Cybersecurity services, including SLAs, OLAs, and related third-party suppliers/vendors/contractors. Interact with consultants to ensure Cybersecurity projects are completed on time, within budget, and to desired quality. Resolve Cybersecurity problems, determine root causes, and suggest improvements. Prepare and provide regular Cybersecurity Reports (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly, Ad Hoc) for the CISO and Management. Apply security policies to meet system security objectives. Perform other duties as assigned by the SOC Manager or the CISO. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in cybersecurity operations or a related field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, contributing to ASMO's internal cybersecurity operations. The role involves collaboration with internal teams, external providers, and consultants to maintain a robust security posture.

2d5cbcb0d51e66bf.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة يبحث مركز كلودينزا للتزيين النسائي عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير تجربة استقبال مميزة للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة الاتصالات الواردة والصادرة بكفاءة عالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة. تنظيم مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على تنظيم المواعيد وإدارة السجلات بكفاءة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفرغ للعمل في مركز كلودينزا للتزيين النسائي بالخبر. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

2d8e5bd0b58c0f62.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية عن مترجم للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور دراسة العلوم اللغوية بلغتين على الأقل، مع التركيز على القواعد والمصطلحات والأساليب الأدبية لمادة الترجمة. سيقوم المترجم بإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بمجال الترجمة وعرضها وحفظها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة أصول وقواعد ومصطلحات اللغة الأم من حيث المرادفات والصرف والنحو، بالإضافة إلى دراسة اللغة الأجنبية من حيث مفرداتها وتراكيبها واشتقاقاتها. دراسة المادة المراد ترجمتها وتحديد أسلوب المعالجة المناسب، والاعتماد على مصادر وقواميس متعددة لتحديد المعاني والمصطلحات في كلتا اللغتين. إجراء عملية الترجمة ومراجعتها وتطويرها لضمان الدقة والجودة. مواكبة التطورات في المصطلحات اللغوية في اللغة الأم واللغة الأجنبية التي يتم الترجمة إليها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال الترجمة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة، وذلك وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الترجمة. إتقان لغتين على الأقل، إحداهما اللغة الأم والأخرى لغة أجنبية. معرفة عميقة بقواعد ومصطلحات وأساليب الترجمة الأدبية والفنية. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الراتب الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى التقديم لهذا الدور.

These reports can be requested internally or externally to inform clients about how well their social media efforts are performing. Experience in any social media role, content creator, or a similar role. Excellent knowledge of any social media tools and trends. 2dd2b6bad8d87aaa.description: About the Role flynas is seeking a Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting and conducting cybersecurity compliance activities to ensure the organization adheres to applicable cybersecurity laws, regulations, policies, standards, and internal requirements. The specialist will contribute to compliance assessments, evidence collection, gap identification, and regulatory reporting. Maintain awareness of applicable cybersecurity compliance obligations and requirements, including changes to regulatory and organizational mandates. Support the review and update of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements to ensure alignment with regulatory mandates. Assist with cybersecurity compliance assessments of vendors and third parties, including the preparation and review of compliance questionnaires and supporting evidence. Maintain and track approved cybersecurity exceptions and waivers, including conditions, compensating controls, owners, approvals, and expiry dates. Prepare periodic cybersecurity compliance reports and contribute to dashboards and management reporting. Coordinate with IT, business units, control owners, and other stakeholders to obtain information and evidence for compliance assessments. Track remediation actions with responsible control and process owners, monitor target dates, and escalate overdue actions. Conduct periodic compliance assessments and checks against applicable cybersecurity regulations, frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements. Collect, review, validate, and maintain supporting evidence to assess the implementation and effectiveness of cybersecurity controls. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

2dbbd86fc1ae0d42.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايفان للخدمات الطبية عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة. الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها، وتشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع كل حالة. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التهاباتها. إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. تطوير العمل والتوثيق المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاج فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق شركة ايفان للخدمات الطبية في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل متكاملة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذا الدور للانضمام إلى فريقنا في الرياض.

Collaborate with Technical Trainers to identify skill gaps and implement structured development plans. Build and maintain a knowledge base of common faults, diagnostic approaches, and OEM technical updates. Quality, Warranty, and Continuous Improvement Ensure all technical work meets OEM diagnostic and repair standards to support warranty claim approval and audit readiness. 2d75d122f5976b5e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة وئام الحجاز للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في خليص، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. وضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشروعات. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. التأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. فهم جيد لوحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة وئام الحجاز للمقاولات في مدينة خليص، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني والتعامل مع مختلف أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

2d81b4c0822358bc.description: About the Role Basic Chemical Industries Group is seeking a Supply Planning Specialist to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time role involves maintaining accurate planning data, inventory policies, and master data within the ERP/SAP system to develop and manage supply plans. 2d9420e60d89d797.job_title: Field Compliance Coordinator (Drilling Safety & Environment) - Saudi Arabia
2d9420e60d89d797.description: The Field Compliance Coordinator is responsible for supporting Saudi Aramco Upstream Drilling & Workover Operations by ensuring full compliance with Saudi Aramco HSE requirements, drilling standards, and regulatory obligations. The role serves as the field HSE focal point for assigned rigs, promoting safe drilling operations through audits, inspections, incident investigations, risk management, and continuous improvement of safety performance. Act as the Field HSE Advisor for assigned drilling and workover rigs, ensuring compliance with Saudi Aramco HSE Management System (SMS), General Instructions (GIs), and Upstream Drilling standards. Conduct routine HSE audits, field inspections, and compliance assessments, issuing Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and tracking corrective actions to closure. Lead and participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive and corrective actions. Support pre-commencement inspections for new drilling rigs and prepare rigs for Saudi Aramco RHSEI, Well Control, Loss Prevention Department (LPD), Corporate, and Environmental Protection Department (EPD) audits. Facilitate hazard identification, risk assessments, emergency preparedness, contractor HSE compliance, and environmental protection initiatives. Mentor rig foremen, supervisors, and Safety Officers to strengthen HSE leadership and improve field safety performance. Conduct behavioral safety observations, participate in rig safety meetings, and promote a proactive safety culture across drilling operations. Prepare HSE reports, compliance documentation, and performance metrics as required by Saudi Aramco management. Qualifications & Experience. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized university. NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC), IOSH Managing Safely, or equivalent internationally recognized HSE certification. Minimum 10 years of HSE experience in the oil and gas industry, including at least 7 years supporting Saudi Aramco or major upstream drilling/workover operations. Strong knowledge of Saudi Aramco Safety Management System (SMS), drilling HSE requirements, incident investigation, risk assessment, emergency response, and audit processes. Demonstrated experience supporting Saudi Aramco drilling compliance audits, field inspections, and HSE performance improvement programs. Excellent communication, leadership, report writing, and stakeholder coordination skills.
